documentControl.natureZh: 项目级数据治理控制说明；不是 CCDC、Creative Commons、NIST、Zenodo、Figshare 或其他发布方颁发的授权证书
documentControl.natureEn: Project-level data-governance control statement; not an authorization certificate issued by CCDC, Creative Commons, NIST, Zenodo, Figshare, or another publisher
documentControl.ownerZh: EcoMOF-AI 数据治理与来源登记
documentControl.ownerEn: EcoMOF-AI data governance and source registry
documentControl.reviewCycleZh: 来源条款、数据版本、预期用途或非商业运营边界发生变化时立即重新核验
documentControl.reviewCycleEn: Re-verify immediately whenever source terms, dataset versions, intended use, or the non-commercial operating boundary changes

operatingMode.zh: EcoMOF-AI 的公开数据使用范围限定为非商业研究；任何超出来源许可的用途均不因访问本网站而获得授权。
operatingMode.en: EcoMOF-AI limits public data use to non-commercial research; access to this website does not authorize any use beyond the source terms.

statusStatement.zh: EcoMOF-AI 按非商业研究模式运行。当前物化性质主层为 9,835 条 CoRE MOF 2024 CSD-modified CR 结构记录；FAIR-MOFs 仅在 CSD Refcode 完全一致时提供独立交叉记录。许可、来源和科学适用性必须按具体数据对象分别判断。
statusStatement.en: EcoMOF-AI operates in non-commercial research mode. The primary physicochemical layer contains 9,835 CoRE MOF 2024 CSD-modified CR structure records; FAIR-MOFs supplies an independent cross-record only for an identical CSD Refcode. Licence, provenance, and scientific fitness must be assessed for each data object.

accessBoundary.zh: 访问本网站不等于获得任何数据库的商业许可、再许可或超出原许可的权利。每个数据对象继续受其来源许可、合同条款、论文版权及其他适用权利约束。
accessBoundary.en: Access to this website does not grant a commercial licence, sublicence, or any right beyond the source terms. Each data object remains subject to its source licence, contractual terms, article copyright, and other applicable rights.

notLegalAdvice.zh: 本页是项目级合规说明与使用提示，不替代律师意见、机构许可审查或 CCDC/数据发布方的书面确认。
notLegalAdvice.en: This page is a project compliance statement and use notice. It does not replace legal advice, institutional licence review, or written confirmation from CCDC or another data publisher.

controlWorkflow.bodyZh: 确认具体记录、字段、CIF、等温线或文献事实来自哪个数据库，并保留数据库名、记录标识、版本和原始链接。
controlWorkflow.bodyEn: Identify the database behind the specific record, field, CIF, isotherm, or literature fact, preserving database name, record identifier, version, and original link.

controlWorkflow.bodyZh: 区分站内浏览、非商业研究、论文发表、模型训练、再分发、客户交付、收费产品和学术—商业联合项目；用途不同，授权边界可能不同。
controlWorkflow.bodyEn: Distinguish site browsing, non-commercial research, publication, model training, redistribution, client delivery, paid products, and academic-commercial joint projects; permission boundaries can differ by use.

controlWorkflow.bodyZh: 同时核对数据集页面、许可正文、附加下载条款、机构协议和记录级来源；不得只依据 EcoMOF-AI 的摘要作判断。
controlWorkflow.bodyEn: Check the dataset page, licence text, additional download terms, institutional agreement, and record-level source together; do not rely on the EcoMOF-AI summary alone.

controlWorkflow.bodyZh: 落实非商业、相同方式共享、禁止规避许可、禁止误示背书、署名、许可链接和修改说明等要求。
controlWorkflow.bodyEn: Apply non-commercial, share-alike, no-circumvention, no-endorsement, attribution, licence-link, and change-notice requirements.

controlWorkflow.bodyZh: 在公开下载、批量导出、对外共享、模型发布或商业使用前，确认是否需要 CCDC、数据发布方、所属机构或其他权利人的书面许可。
controlWorkflow.bodyEn: Before public download, bulk export, external sharing, model release, or commercial use, determine whether written permission is required from CCDC, the publisher, the institution, or another rightsholder.

controlWorkflow.bodyZh: 记录核验日期、适用版本、使用目的、责任人、原文链接、修改说明和最终决定；条款或用途变化后重新进入核验流程。
controlWorkflow.bodyEn: Record review date, applicable version, purpose, responsible person, original links, changes, and final decision; restart review when terms or use change.

ccdcDecisionRules.ruleZh: CCDC 下载页将其标为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；仅在许可允许的非商业范围内使用，保留署名、许可链接和修改说明。商业公司或商业用途需要另行取得许可。
ccdcDecisionRules.ruleEn: The CCDC download page identifies it as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Use only within the licence's non-commercial scope and preserve attribution, the licence link, and change notices. Commercial companies or uses require separate licensing.
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionZh: 当前站点：允许非商业研究接入；商业输出保持阻断。
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionEn: Current site decision: ingest for non-commercial research; block commercial outputs.

ccdcDecisionRules.ruleZh: CCDC 下载页将 modified CIFs 标为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，并要求下载者同时接受 CCDC 标准许可协议；不得把该开放范围扩张为完整 CSD 的开放许可。
ccdcDecisionRules.ruleEn: The CCDC download page identifies modified CIFs as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and also requires acceptance of the CCDC standard licence agreement. Do not extend this scope into an open licence for the full CSD.
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionZh: 当前站点：仅接入 CSD-modified CR 子集，并披露索引与派生处理。
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionEn: Current site decision: ingest only the CSD-modified CR subset and disclose indexing and derivation.

ccdcDecisionRules.objectZh: CoRE-MOF unmodified CIFs / 完整付费 CSD
ccdcDecisionRules.objectEn: CoRE-MOF unmodified CIFs / full paid CSD
ccdcDecisionRules.ruleZh: CCDC 明确要求有效 CSD 许可；其再分发 FAQ 说明付费 CSD 原始数据不得向组织外批量共享，派生数据或模型的外部共享可能需要另行确认。
ccdcDecisionRules.ruleEn: CCDC expressly requires a valid CSD licence. Its redistribution FAQ states that original paid-CSD data must not be shared in bulk outside the organisation, and external sharing of derived data or models may require separate confirmation.
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionZh: 当前站点：不接入、不发布、不提供下载，也不帮助用户规避 CSD 许可。
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionEn: Current site decision: do not ingest, publish, or offer downloads, and do not facilitate licence circumvention.

ccdcDecisionRules.objectZh: 学术—商业联合项目与商业化计划
ccdcDecisionRules.ruleZh: CCDC Conditions of Use 提示：涉及 CSD Portfolio 的派生软件/数据对外分发，以及学术机构与营利机构联合使用，可能需要 CCDC 事先书面批准；应以实际机构协议和 CCDC 书面答复为准。
ccdcDecisionRules.ruleEn: CCDC Conditions of Use indicate that distribution of software/data derived from the CSD Portfolio and joint academic-for-profit use may require prior written CCDC approval. The actual institutional agreement and written CCDC response control.
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionZh: 当前站点：用途一旦涉及客户、收费、商业公司或产品化，先停止相关再利用并取得书面确认。
ccdcDecisionRules.decisionEn: Current site decision: when a use involves clients, fees, commercial entities, or productization, stop the affected reuse and obtain written confirmation first.

applicableClauseGroups.titleZh: CCDC：数据对象、机构协议与再分发边界
applicableClauseGroups.titleEn: CCDC: data objects, institutional agreements, and redistribution
applicableClauseGroups.scopeZh: 适用于 CSD MOF Collection、CoRE-MOF modified/unmodified CIF、完整付费 CSD，以及利用 CSD Portfolio 形成的派生软件、数据或模型。
applicableClauseGroups.scopeEn: Applies to the CSD MOF Collection, CoRE-MOF modified/unmodified CIFs, the full paid CSD, and software, data, or models derived using the CSD Portfolio.

clauses.titleZh: 公开非商业集合的授权对象
clauses.titleEn: Licensed object for the public non-commercial collection
clauses.bodyZh: CCDC 下载页仅将 CSD MOF Collection（Non-Commercial）这一特定集合标为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；不得据此推断完整 CSD、商业版集合或其他 CCDC 数据也采用同一开放许可。
clauses.bodyEn: The CCDC downloads page applies CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 to the specific CSD MOF Collection (Non-Commercial). This does not place the full CSD, commercial collection, or other CCDC data under the same public licence.

clauses.titleZh: modified CIF 的独立许可边界
clauses.titleEn: Separate licence boundary for modified CIFs
clauses.bodyZh: CoRE-MOF modified CIFs 在 CCDC 下载页被单独标为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，并同时指向 CCDC 标准许可协议；授权只覆盖下载项明确指定的 modified CIF。
clauses.bodyEn: CCDC lists CoRE-MOF modified CIFs separately under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and also points to its standard licence agreement. The grant covers only the modified CIF download item identified there.

clauses.titleZh: unmodified CIF 需要有效 CSD 许可
clauses.titleEn: Unmodified CIFs require a valid CSD licence
clauses.bodyZh: CoRE-MOF unmodified CIFs 不是公开许可数据；下载需要有效 CSD 许可及 CCDC 提供的访问凭据，项目不得以 modified 数据的许可替代该要求。
clauses.bodyEn: CoRE-MOF unmodified CIFs are not public-licence data. Download requires a valid CSD licence and CCDC access credentials; the licence for modified data cannot substitute for that requirement.

clauses.titleZh: 付费 CSD 原始数据不得向组织外批量共享
clauses.titleEn: No external bulk sharing of original paid-CSD data
clauses.bodyZh: 付费 CSD 许可可支持搜索、查看、计算和模型训练，但不允许向组织外提供原始 CSD 数据的批量副本，例如公开批量 CIF。
clauses.bodyEn: A paid CSD licence can support search, viewing, calculations, and model training, but does not permit bulk copies of original CSD data, such as bulk CIFs, to be shared outside the organisation.

clauses.titleZh: 派生数据或模型对外共享需要另行确认
clauses.titleEn: External sharing of derived data or models requires confirmation
clauses.bodyZh: 拟对外共享由付费 CSD 形成的派生数据或模型时，不能自行认定允许；应向 CCDC 确认现有机构协议是否覆盖，或是否需要单独协议。
clauses.bodyEn: External sharing of data or models derived from the paid CSD must not be assumed permitted. CCDC should confirm whether the institutional agreement covers the use or a separate agreement is required.

clauses.titleZh: 指定机构、地点与期限
clauses.titleEn: Specified organisation, location, and term
clauses.bodyZh: CSD Portfolio 组件受机构协议约束，通常限于指定组织、指定地点和许可期限；个人访问权限不能当然转移给其他组织或公共网站。
clauses.bodyEn: CSD Portfolio components are governed by institutional agreements and are generally limited to a specified organisation, location, and licence term. Individual access cannot automatically be transferred to another organisation or public website.

clauses.titleZh: 保密与第三方再分发限制
clauses.titleEn: Confidentiality and third-party redistribution
clauses.bodyZh: 属于 CSD Portfolio 的组件应按适用协议保密，不得以全部或部分形式向第三方披露或再分发；单独供应且另有许可的组件以其专门许可为准。
clauses.bodyEn: Components within the CSD Portfolio are confidential under the applicable agreement and must not be disclosed or redistributed, in whole or part, to third parties. A separately supplied component is controlled by its separate licence.

clauses.titleZh: 派生软件或数据分发的事先书面批准
clauses.titleEn: Prior written approval for distributing derived software or data
clauses.bodyZh: 利用 CSD Portfolio 开发或派生的软件、数据如需分发，应先取得 CCDC 书面批准；项目内部的技术处理记录不是该批准的替代物。
clauses.bodyEn: Software or data developed from or derived using the CSD Portfolio requires prior written CCDC approval before distribution. An internal project processing record is not a substitute for that approval.

clauses.titleZh: 学术—营利联合项目的事先批准
clauses.titleEn: Prior approval for academic-for-profit joint projects
clauses.bodyZh: 学术机构与营利机构联合使用 CSD Portfolio 时，需要按 CCDC Conditions of Use 取得事先书面批准，并核对双方机构协议。
clauses.bodyEn: Joint academic-for-profit use of the CSD Portfolio requires prior written approval under the CCDC Conditions of Use and review of both organisations' agreements.

clauses.titleZh: 科研发表、引用与免责声明
clauses.titleEn: Scientific publication, citation, and disclaimer
clauses.bodyZh: 在机构协议允许的科研范围内可以发表结果，但须按协议附表和 CCDC 网站作适当引用；CCDC 对组件不作保证并在法律允许范围内限制责任。
clauses.bodyEn: Scientific results may be published where the institutional agreement permits, with the citation required by the agreement schedule and CCDC website. CCDC provides no warranties and limits liability to the extent permitted by law.

clauses.titleZh: 修改标记与署名移除
clauses.titleEn: Modification notices and attribution removal
clauses.bodyZh: 说明是否修改并保留既有修改记录；发布方合理要求移除指定署名信息时，应在可行范围内处理；改编许可不得阻止接收者遵守 CC BY。
clauses.bodyEn: Indicate modifications and retain prior change notices; honor reasonable requests to remove designated attribution where practicable; and do not apply an adapter's licence that prevents CC BY compliance.

clauses.titleZh: 特殊数据库权利
clauses.titleEn: Sui generis database rights
clauses.bodyZh: 在适用特殊数据库权利的地区，可抽取和分享全部或实质性内容，但分享实质性内容时仍须履行署名等条件；新数据库本身可能构成改编材料。
clauses.bodyEn: Where sui generis database rights apply, all or a substantial portion may be extracted and shared subject to attribution, and a new database containing substantial contents may itself be Adapted Material.

clauses.titleZh: 无保证与责任限制
clauses.titleEn: No warranties and limitation of liability
clauses.bodyZh: 材料按现状和可用状态提供，准确性、完整性、适用性和不侵权等不获保证；损失责任在法律允许范围内受限。
clauses.bodyEn: Material is provided as-is and as-available without warranties of accuracy, completeness, fitness, or non-infringement, and liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.

clauses.titleZh: 终止、恢复、独立协议与解释
clauses.titleEn: Termination, reinstatement, separate agreements, and interpretation
clauses.bodyZh: 违反条件会自动终止；发现后 30 日内补救可自动恢复，或由许可人明确恢复。另行约定独立存在，不因沉默而放弃条款，部分无效不影响其他条款。
clauses.bodyEn: Breach causes automatic termination; cure within 30 days of discovery can reinstate rights, or the licensor may expressly reinstate them. Separate arrangements remain independent, waiver is not implied, and severability applies.

applicableClauseGroups.titleZh: NIST、文献与逐记录权利边界
applicableClauseGroups.titleEn: NIST, literature, and record-level rights boundaries
applicableClauseGroups.scopeZh: 适用于 NIST/ARPA-E ISODB 记录、关联论文、DOI、人工整理事实以及没有覆盖性数据集许可的来源。
applicableClauseGroups.scopeEn: Applies to NIST/ARPA-E ISODB records, linked articles, DOIs, manually curated facts, and sources without a blanket dataset licence.

clauses.titleZh: NIST 数据库声明不是覆盖性再许可
clauses.titleEn: The NIST database notice is not a blanket relicence
clauses.bodyZh: NIST 页面说明数据库由其汇编并提供免责声明，但未在页面上向本项目授予覆盖所有记录、论文内容和再分发行为的统一开放许可；因此按记录保留来源并限制为事实性字段。
clauses.bodyEn: NIST states that it compiled the database and provides disclaimers, but the page does not grant this project a blanket open licence covering every record, article content, and redistribution use. Keep per-record sources and limit use to factual fields.

clauses.titleZh: 质量、错误与不背书声明
clauses.titleEn: Quality, error, and no-endorsement notice
clauses.bodyZh: NIST 尽力提供高质量副本，但不保证无错误或遗漏；页面提及商业设备、材料或链接不表示 NIST 推荐或背书。
clauses.bodyEn: NIST uses best efforts to provide a high-quality copy but does not warrant absence of errors or omissions. References to commercial equipment, materials, or links do not imply NIST recommendation or endorsement.

clauses.titleZh: 数据库记录与关联论文分开核验
clauses.titleEn: Review database records and linked articles separately
clauses.bodyZh: 数据库中的数值、元数据和论文链接不意味着论文正文、图表、补充材料或出版商版本可被复制；需要逐项识别事实字段与受版权保护表达。
clauses.bodyEn: Values, metadata, and article links in a database do not make article text, figures, supplements, or publisher versions freely copyable. Factual fields and protected expression must be distinguished record by record.

clauses.titleZh: DOI 和引用不是授权凭证
clauses.titleEn: A DOI or citation is not authorization evidence
clauses.bodyZh: DOI、文献引用和可公开访问状态只证明来源定位，不自动证明复制、全文挖掘、再分发、模型训练或商业使用获得许可。
clauses.bodyEn: A DOI, citation, or public accessibility establishes source location but does not automatically authorize copying, full-text mining, redistribution, model training, or commercial use.

clauses.titleZh: 许可未知或 pending 时停止公开复用
clauses.titleEn: Stop public reuse when terms are unknown or pending
clauses.bodyZh: 来源登记为 unknown、pending、restricted 或缺少逐记录凭证时，不得将其作为已授权开放数据对外导出、再分发或用于权利敏感的训练与商业用途。
clauses.bodyEn: When the registry says unknown, pending, restricted, or lacks per-record evidence, do not present the material as authorized open data or use it for public export, redistribution, rights-sensitive training, or commercial purposes.

clauses.titleZh: 出版商、机构和第三方权利继续适用
clauses.titleEn: Publisher, institutional, and third-party rights continue to apply
clauses.bodyZh: 出版商条款、机构订阅协议、第三方版权、数据库权、专利、商标、隐私和保密义务不因录入来源登记而消失；冲突时应停止并取得权利人或机构确认。
clauses.bodyEn: Publisher terms, institutional subscriptions, third-party copyright, database rights, patents, trademarks, privacy, and confidentiality obligations are not displaced by a source-registry entry. Stop and obtain rightsholder or institutional confirmation when conflicts arise.

applicableClauseGroups.titleZh: 项目软件、派生结果与凭证真实性
applicableClauseGroups.titleEn: Project software, derived outputs, and evidence authenticity
applicableClauseGroups.scopeZh: 用于防止把 EcoMOF-AI 的软件许可、来源登记、NOTICE 或内部审核记录误认为第三方数据授权。
applicableClauseGroups.scopeEn: Prevents the EcoMOF-AI software licence, source registry, NOTICE files, or internal reviews from being mistaken for third-party data authorization.

clauses.titleZh: MIT 只许可项目软件
clauses.titleEn: MIT licenses project software only
clauses.bodyZh: 仓库根目录 MIT License 适用于项目自有软件代码，不会把 CCDC、NIST、Zenodo、Figshare、论文出版商或其他第三方数据重新许可为 MIT。
clauses.bodyEn: The repository's MIT License applies to project-owned software code and does not relicence CCDC, NIST, Zenodo, Figshare, publisher, or other third-party data under MIT.

clauses.titleZh: 来源登记是审计记录，不是授权书
clauses.titleEn: The source registry is an audit record, not a licence grant
clauses.bodyZh: 登记来源、许可标签、DOI、哈希和处理方式只证明项目记录了这些信息；它不代表发布方认可项目判断，也不产生原许可之外的权利。
clauses.bodyEn: Recording source, licence labels, DOI, hashes, and handling shows what the project documented. It does not mean the publisher approved the project's interpretation or grant rights beyond the source terms.

clauses.titleZh: 项目生成的 NOTICE 不是 CCDC 凭证
clauses.titleEn: Project-generated NOTICE files are not CCDC credentials
clauses.bodyZh: 构建脚本生成的 NOTICE.md、LICENSE-DATA.md 和数据包 README 用于向下游传递来源与许可信息，属于项目制作的合规工件，不是 CCDC 出具的证书、批文或个别授权。
clauses.bodyEn: NOTICE.md, LICENSE-DATA.md, and dataset README files produced by build scripts pass source and licence information downstream. They are project-generated compliance artifacts, not CCDC-issued certificates, approvals, or individual permissions.

clauses.titleZh: 派生分数不当然脱离来源权利
clauses.titleEn: Derived scores do not automatically escape source rights
clauses.bodyZh: 规范化字段、匹配结果、评分、排名、模型参数和可视化即使由项目计算，也可能继续受到来源合同、数据库权或再分发边界影响，必须按输入来源和拟议用途核验。
clauses.bodyEn: Normalized fields, matches, scores, rankings, model parameters, and visualizations may remain affected by source contracts, database rights, or redistribution limits even when project-computed. Review the inputs and intended use.

clauses.titleZh: 只有发布方或权利人材料可作为外部授权凭证
clauses.titleEn: Only publisher or rightsholder materials are external authorization evidence
clauses.bodyZh: 公开许可页面、法律文本、机构协议、发布方书面答复或权利人出具的许可才可证明外部授权。项目自述、测试通过、文件日期、提交记录或界面标签均不能替代这些凭证。
clauses.bodyEn: External authorization can be evidenced by a public licence page, legal code, institutional agreement, publisher's written response, or rightsholder permission. Project statements, passing tests, document dates, commits, or UI labels cannot substitute for that evidence.

authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: CCDC 官方下载页将该特定集合标为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；只支持许可定义下的非商业使用，不构成商业许可。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: The official CCDC downloads page identifies this specific collection as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. It supports only NonCommercial use within that licence and is not a commercial licence.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 没有发现 CCDC 向 EcoMOF-AI 出具的个别授权证书；所依据的是面向公众的下载条款。15,906 条索引/CIF 在独立数据仓库中与应用代码分发；本仓库试点 manifest 仍标记需认证下载，不能把未经核验的同名外部结构冒充该集合成员。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: No individual CCDC authorization certificate issued to EcoMOF-AI is recorded; the evidence is the public download terms. The 15,906-entry index/CIF package is distributed separately from the app code. This repository's pilot manifest still requires authenticated download and does not permit unverified same-name external structures to be presented as collection members.

authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 公开许可与来源凭证存在
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: Public licence and source evidence available
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: CCDC 下载项把 modified CIF 标为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；项目仅登记并接入 9,835 条 CSD-modified CR 记录。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: CCDC lists the modified CIF download under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The project registers and ingests only the 9,835 CSD-modified CR records.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 该凭证不覆盖 unmodified CIF、完整付费 CSD 或商业用途；CCDC 下载项还引用标准许可协议，实际机构协议优先。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: This evidence does not cover unmodified CIFs, the full paid CSD, or commercial use. The CCDC download item also references the standard agreement, and the actual institutional agreement prevails.

authorizationCredentials.sourceZh: CoRE-MOF unmodified CIF / 完整付费 CSD
authorizationCredentials.sourceEn: CoRE-MOF unmodified CIFs / full paid CSD
authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 本项目无覆盖性授权凭证，保持阻断
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: CCDC 要求有效 CSD 机构许可；当前仓库没有可证明 EcoMOF-AI 有权公开再分发这些原始数据的机构协议或 CCDC 个别书面批准。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: CCDC requires a valid institutional CSD licence. This repository contains no agreement or individual written CCDC approval showing that EcoMOF-AI may publicly redistribute this original data.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 不得接入公开数据层、公开批量 CIF、对外打包或以 modified 集合的 CC 许可替代。派生数据/模型外发与学术—商业联合项目也需另行确认。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: Do not ingest into the public layer, publish bulk CIFs, package externally, or substitute the modified collection's CC licence. External derived-data/model sharing and academic-commercial projects also require separate confirmation.

evidence.label: CCDC · Can I redistribute data from the CSD?

authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 公开许可与文件校验凭证存在
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: Public licence and file-verification evidence available
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: Zenodo 数据集记录将 FAIR-MOFs 标为 CC BY 4.0，并公布 DOI、逐文件清单与校验值。项目使用 porosity_of_unoptimised_mof.json 建立严格 Refcode 交叉层，并保留来源文件 MD5。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: The Zenodo dataset record identifies FAIR-MOFs as CC BY 4.0 and publishes its DOI, file inventory, and checksums. The project uses porosity_of_unoptimised_mof.json for a strict Refcode cross-layer and retains the source-file MD5.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 37,452 条 FAIR 孔隙记录不直接并入 CoRE 身份层；只有 3,451 条与当前 CoRE 结构的 CSD Refcode 完全一致。其余记录不以 DOI、化学式、基础 Refcode 或名称相似度强行合并。CC BY 不覆盖发布者无权许可的第三方权利。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: The 37,452 FAIR porosity records are not directly merged into the CoRE identity layer. Only 3,451 have an identical CSD Refcode in the current CoRE corpus. The remainder are not force-joined by DOI, formula, base Refcode, or name similarity. CC BY does not cover third-party rights the publisher lacks authority to license.

authorizationCredentials.sourceZh: NIST/ARPA-E ISODB 与逐记录吸附来源
authorizationCredentials.sourceEn: NIST/ARPA-E ISODB and record-level adsorption sources
authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 无覆盖性开放许可，逐记录核验
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: No blanket open licence; record-level review
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: NIST 官方页面可证明数据库发布方、数据库用途说明和免责声明；每条等温线还保留 sourceDatabase、sourceUrl、license/citation 等来源字段。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: The official NIST page evidences the database publisher, purpose, and disclaimer. Each isotherm also retains sourceDatabase, sourceUrl, licence/citation, and other provenance fields.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: NIST 页面未向本项目提供覆盖关联论文、全部记录和再分发的统一开放许可。不存在逐记录许可证据时，只能保留事实性来源登记，不得复制论文表达或宣称统一授权。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: The NIST page does not grant this project a blanket open licence covering linked articles, every record, and redistribution. Without per-record licence evidence, retain factual provenance only and do not copy article expression or claim blanket authorization.

evidence.label: NIST Data Resources for Adsorption Science and Technology

authorizationCredentials.sourceZh: 真实种子与文献 DOI 记录
authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 仅有逐记录来源线索，不是覆盖性授权
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: Record-level source leads only; no blanket authorization
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: 11 条真实种子保留逐记录 DOI；这可以证明来源定位，但不能替代出版商许可。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: Eleven real-seed records retain per-record DOIs. This supports source identification but does not replace publisher permission.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 不得把 DOI、题录或公开摘要解释为论文全文、图表、补充材料、实验标签或商业使用的授权凭证。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: Do not interpret a DOI, citation, or public abstract as permission for article full text, figures, supplements, experimental labels, or commercial use.

authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: 当前来源登记没有可证明 50 条结构种子统一授权范围的许可凭证。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: The current source registry contains no licence evidence establishing a common authorization scope for the 50 structural seed records.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 不得把名称中的 Open 解释为开放许可；逐记录 DOI/许可确认前，阻断对外导出、再分发、权利敏感训练与商业用途。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: The word Open in the name is not an open licence. Block external export, redistribution, rights-sensitive training, and commercial use until per-record DOI/licence review is complete.

authorizationCredentials.sourceZh: Organic Acid 文献、证据与实验记录
authorizationCredentials.sourceEn: Organic Acid literature, evidence, and experiment records
authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 许可 pending，按演示/证据线索处理
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: Licence pending; handled as demonstration/evidence leads
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: 来源登记保留记录文件、证据等级和已知来源，但没有覆盖这些记录的统一许可凭证。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: The source registry preserves record files, evidence tiers, and known sources, but has no blanket licence evidence covering these records.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 缺少 DOI 或许可确认的记录不得冒充已核验实验标签或开放数据；不能复制受版权保护的论文表达、图表或补充材料。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: Records without confirmed DOI or licence evidence must not be presented as verified experimental labels or open data, and protected article expression, figures, or supplements must not be copied.

authorizationCredentials.sourceZh: 项目自有软件、专家记录与合成演示数据
authorizationCredentials.sourceEn: Project-owned software, expert notes, and synthetic demonstration data
authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 项目来源证据存在，必须与第三方数据分开
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: Project-origin evidence available; keep separate from third-party data
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: 软件代码受仓库 MIT License 约束；专家评审和 syntheticFixture 由项目内部生成并在来源登记中标记。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: Software code is governed by the repository MIT License. Expert review and syntheticFixture records are project-generated and labelled in the source registry.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: MIT 不重新许可第三方数据；专家意见不是实验测量，合成夹具不是 ground truth，也不能用项目 NOTICE 冒充发布方授权。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: MIT does not relicence third-party data. Expert opinion is not an experimental measurement, synthetic fixtures are not ground truth, and project NOTICE files are not publisher authorization.

authorizationCredentials.sourceZh: MOF Anatomy 名称与文献身份目录
authorizationCredentials.sourceEn: MOF Anatomy name and literature identity directory
authorizationCredentials.statusZh: 仅使用事实性元数据；未发现站点统一再利用许可
authorizationCredentials.statusEn: Factual metadata only; no site-wide reuse licence located
authorizationCredentials.authorizationZh: 公开页面提供 MOF 名称、年份、分类、原论文 DOI 和 CCDC 号等事实性来源指针。此登记不把公开可访问等同于获得结构文件、图片或页面表达的复制许可。
authorizationCredentials.authorizationEn: Public pages provide factual source pointers such as MOF names, year, class, source-paper DOI, and CCDC number. This record does not treat public access as permission to copy structure files, images, or page expression.
authorizationCredentials.limitationZh: 不得复制或再分发 MOF Anatomy 的结构图片、XYZ 文件、整理后结构、页面文案或视觉设计；没有独立许可与精确标识符时，不得把该目录条目补写成物化性质记录。
authorizationCredentials.limitationEn: Do not copy or redistribute MOF Anatomy structure images, XYZ files, cleaned structures, page prose, or visual design. Without independent permission and an exact identifier, a directory entry must not be converted into a physicochemical-property record.

incidentResponse.zh: 接收权利声明、错误报告或移除请求，并记录提交人、受影响记录、来源链接和问题类型。
incidentResponse.en: Receive the rights notice, error report, or removal request and record the reporter, affected record, source link, and issue type.

incidentResponse.zh: 对存在合理争议的记录先暂停展示、计算、下载和对外导出，防止问题继续扩散。
incidentResponse.en: Temporarily suspend display, computation, download, and external export for reasonably disputed records to contain the issue.

incidentResponse.zh: 核对来源文件、许可版本、字段级溯源、身份映射、修改记录与实际使用方式；必要时联系发布方或专业顾问。
incidentResponse.en: Verify source files, licence version, field provenance, identity mapping, change history, and actual use; contact the publisher or qualified adviser where needed.

incidentResponse.zh: 形成恢复、更正、限制、替换或永久移除决定，并记录理由、证据、责任人与日期。
incidentResponse.en: Decide whether to restore, correct, restrict, replace, or permanently remove the record, documenting reasons, evidence, owner, and date.

incidentResponse.zh: 在联系方式可用且适当时向请求方反馈处理结果；同步更新来源登记、条款复核记录和相关导出说明。
incidentResponse.en: Where contact details are available and appropriate, notify the requester of the outcome and update the source registry, terms-review record, and affected export notices.

definitions.definitionZh: 由第三方发布方提供的 CIF、表格、等温线、文本、元数据或其他数据对象。
definitions.definitionEn: CIFs, tables, isotherms, text, metadata, or other data objects supplied by a third-party publisher.

definitions.definitionZh: 为检索、映射或分页而重新组织的记录清单；不等于获得原始数据的再许可。
definitions.definitionEn: A record list reorganized for search, mapping, or pagination; it does not relicence source data.

definitions.definitionZh: 由规范化、聚合、计算、文本挖掘、匹配或模型产生的值；仍可能受到来源权利与合同边界影响。
definitions.definitionEn: A value produced through normalization, aggregation, calculation, text mining, matching, or modelling; source rights and contractual boundaries may still apply.

definitions.definitionZh: 向第三方提供数据副本、批量导出、档案、镜像、打包数据或其他可替代原始访问的内容。
definitions.definitionEn: Providing third parties with copies, bulk exports, archives, mirrors, packaged datasets, or other material that can substitute for source access.

definitions.definitionZh: 是否构成商业用途应以适用许可、机构协议和权利人解释为准；客户交付、收费产品、商业模型或营利机构联合项目均必须触发额外审查。
definitions.definitionEn: Commercial-use status is controlled by the applicable licence, institutional agreement, and rightsholder interpretation. Client delivery, paid products, commercial models, and for-profit joint projects all trigger additional review.

definitions.definitionZh: 记录来源、版本、许可、允许范围、限制、本站处理方式、链接和复核日期的审计表。
definitions.definitionEn: An audit record of source, version, licence, permitted scope, restrictions, site handling, links, and review date.

platformCommitments.zh: 只在已记录的来源、版本、许可和用途范围内接入数据；不把“可以访问”解释为“可以任意再分发或商用”。
platformCommitments.en: Ingest data only within the recorded source, version, licence, and use scope; never treat access as permission for unrestricted redistribution or commercial use.

platformCommitments.zh: 在数据页、来源登记和导出说明中保留数据库名称、发布者、URL/DOI、许可链接与必要署名。
platformCommitments.en: Preserve database name, publisher, URL/DOI, licence link, and required attribution in data views, source registries, and export notices.

platformCommitments.zh: 明确区分原始下载文件、重组索引、字段标准化、派生分数与算法输出，并说明发生过的修改。
platformCommitments.en: Distinguish original downloads, reorganized indexes, normalized fields, derived scores, and algorithm outputs, and disclose modifications.

platformCommitments.zh: 对带 NC 条款的 CSD MOF Collection 与 CoRE-MOF CSD-modified 数据仅作非商业研究用途；商业用途在取得适当书面许可前保持禁用。
platformCommitments.en: Use NC-licensed CSD MOF Collection and CoRE-MOF CSD-modified data only for non-commercial research; keep commercial use disabled until appropriate written permission is obtained.

platformCommitments.zh: 不公开再分发完整付费 CSD 的原始批量 CIF，也不公开 CoRE-MOF unmodified CSD CIF；这些内容只有在适用 CSD 许可明确允许时才能由许可持有人使用。
platformCommitments.en: Do not publicly redistribute original bulk CIFs from the full paid CSD or CoRE-MOF unmodified CSD CIFs. Licence holders may use them only where their applicable CSD agreement permits.

platformCommitments.zh: 许可、身份或来源未确认的记录进入隔离区，不参加公开结构浏览、排名或对外导出。
platformCommitments.en: Quarantine records with unresolved licence, identity, or provenance; exclude them from public structure browsing, ranking, and export.

platformCommitments.zh: 来源条款、数据版本、运营模式或商业化计划发生变化时重新审查；收到权利人异议时先暂停相关数据并核验。
platformCommitments.en: Review again when source terms, dataset versions, operating mode, or commercialization plans change; suspend affected data first when a rights-holder concern is received.

userObligations.zh: 在下载、复制、改编、训练模型、发布结果或再分发前，先确认具体记录来自哪个数据库，并阅读该数据库的当前许可与附加条款。
userObligations.en: Before downloading, copying, adapting, training a model, publishing results, or redistributing, identify the source database for the specific record and read its current licence and additional terms.

userObligations.zh: 保留来源名称、发布者、数据集 DOI/URL、许可链接、版权/NOTICE 信息及修改说明；不得移除或弱化原有权利声明。
userObligations.en: Preserve source name, publisher, dataset DOI/URL, licence link, copyright/NOTICE information, and change notices; do not remove or weaken existing rights statements.

userObligations.zh: 对 CSD MOF Collection 与 CoRE-MOF CSD-modified 数据，不得用于主要意图或目的在于商业利益或金钱补偿的活动；如用途可能涉及商业机构、收费产品、客户交付或商业模型，应先向 CCDC/权利人取得书面确认或适当许可。
userObligations.en: Do not use CSD MOF Collection or CoRE-MOF CSD-modified data for activities primarily intended for commercial advantage or monetary compensation. If use may involve a commercial entity, paid product, client delivery, or commercial model, obtain written confirmation or an appropriate licence from CCDC/rightsholders first.

userObligations.zh: 分发基于 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 数据制作的适应性材料时，应在许可要求适用的范围内使用同一许可，并保留署名、许可链接和修改说明；不得附加会限制接收者行使许可权利的法律或技术措施。
userObligations.en: When distributing adapted material based on CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data, apply the same licence where the licence requires it, preserve attribution/licence/change notices, and do not impose legal or technical measures that restrict licensed rights.

userObligations.zh: 再利用 FAIR-MOFs 时应按照 CC BY 4.0 给出适当署名、提供许可链接并注明是否修改；不得暗示作者、Zenodo 或 CCDC 对你的使用、结果或产品背书。
userObligations.en: When reusing FAIR-MOFs under CC BY 4.0, give appropriate credit, link the licence, and indicate changes; do not imply endorsement by the authors, Zenodo, or CCDC.

userObligations.zh: 不得把 EcoMOF-AI 的索引、界面或导出文件视为对第三方原始数据的重新许可；也不得在冲突许可下重新上传、出售、打包或转授权。
userObligations.en: Do not treat an EcoMOF-AI index, interface, or export as a relicence of third-party source data, and do not re-upload, sell, bundle, or sublicense it under conflicting terms.

userObligations.zh: 不得通过本网站规避 CSD 许可、批量抓取不允许再分发的 CSD 原始数据，或向无权访问者提供受限的 unmodified/付费 CSD CIF。
userObligations.en: Do not use this site to bypass CSD licensing, bulk-extract CSD source data that may not be redistributed, or provide restricted unmodified/paid-CSD CIFs to unauthorized users.

userObligations.zh: DOI、书目信息和数据集许可不自动授予论文全文、图片、补充材料、商标、专利或隐私相关权利；这些权利需单独核验。
userObligations.en: A DOI, bibliographic metadata, or dataset licence does not automatically grant rights to article full text, figures, supplements, trademarks, patents, or privacy-controlled material; review those rights separately.

userObligations.zh: 在科研或工程使用前核验来源论文、实验条件、身份映射和派生方法；数据库记录、文本挖掘字段及算法分数均不构成适用性、安全性或性能保证。
userObligations.en: Before scientific or engineering use, verify the source paper, experimental conditions, identity mapping, and derivation method. Database records, text-mined fields, and algorithm scores are not guarantees of fitness, safety, or performance.

userObligations.zh: 你对自己的使用场景、机构政策、适用法律和所需许可承担独立判断责任。若不确定，应停止再利用并咨询所属机构、权利人或专业法律顾问。
userObligations.en: You remain responsible for evaluating your use case, institutional policy, applicable law, and required permissions. If uncertain, stop reuse and consult your institution, the rightsholder, or qualified legal counsel.

datasets.name: CSD MOF Collection (Non-Commercial)
datasets.roleZh: 公共 3D 结构浏览与名称/Refcode 索引
datasets.roleEn: Public 3D structure browsing and name/Refcode index
datasets.version: CSD v601 public MOF collection snapshot
datasets.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus the download page's referenced CCDC standard terms
datasets.allowedZh: 非商业研究中的访问、分析与依许可分享；发布结果时保留 CCDC/数据集署名。
datasets.allowedEn: Access, analysis, and licence-compliant sharing for non-commercial research, with CCDC/dataset attribution in published results.
datasets.prohibitedZh: 不得把该集合用于商业目的；不得把 CSD MOF Collection 的开放许可扩大解释为完整付费 CSD 的批量再分发许可。
datasets.prohibitedEn: No commercial use; do not extend the collection's open terms into permission to bulk-redistribute the full paid CSD.
datasets.projectHandlingZh: 公开仓库保留来源、NOTICE、数据许可和变更说明；CIF 内容保持来源字节，目录与索引重组已披露。
datasets.projectHandlingEn: The public repository preserves source, NOTICE, data licence, and change notices. CIF bytes remain source-identical, while directory/index reorganization is disclosed.

datasets.name: CoRE MOF 2024 · CSD-modified CR
datasets.roleZh: 9,835 条结构记录的主物化性质与描述符层
datasets.roleEn: Primary physicochemical-property and descriptor layer for 9,835 structure records
datasets.version: CoRE MOF 2024 v1.1 · CSD-modified · CR subset
datasets.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus the download page's referenced CCDC standard terms
datasets.allowedZh: 在非商业研究边界内用于结构显示、描述符聚合和派生分析，并保留来源、许可和修改说明。
datasets.allowedEn: Use for structure display, descriptor aggregation, and derived analysis within the non-commercial research boundary, preserving source, licence, and change notices.
datasets.prohibitedZh: 不接入、不发布 CoRE-MOF unmodified CSD CIF；不把 CSD-modified 的许可解释为付费 CSD 原始数据的开放授权。
datasets.prohibitedEn: Do not ingest or publish CoRE-MOF unmodified CSD CIFs, and do not treat CSD-modified terms as an open grant for original paid-CSD data.
datasets.projectHandlingZh: 只接入 CCDC 下载页标明的 modified 数据对象；9,835 条记录逐条显示比表面积、孔体积、PLD、LCD、密度和空隙率。unmodified 数据明确排除，所有展示标注非商业研究边界。
datasets.projectHandlingEn: Only the modified data object identified on the CCDC download page is ingested. All 9,835 records expose surface area, pore volume, PLD, LCD, density, and void fraction. Unmodified data are explicitly excluded and every display retains the non-commercial research boundary.

datasets.name: FAIR-MOFs
datasets.roleZh: 37,452 条孔隙性质记录、4,168 条合成条件/DOI 记录与严格 Refcode 交叉证据层
datasets.roleEn: 37,452 porosity records, 4,168 synthesis-condition/DOI records, and a strict Refcode cross-evidence layer
datasets.allowedZh: 依 CC BY 4.0 复制、再利用与改编数据，同时给出适当署名、许可链接和修改说明。
datasets.allowedEn: Copy, reuse, and adapt under CC BY 4.0 with appropriate credit, licence link, and indication of changes.
datasets.prohibitedZh: 不得暗示来源方背书，不得以 FAIR-MOFs 的 CC BY 许可覆盖其关联论文全文或另有权利约束的底层晶体数据。
datasets.prohibitedEn: Do not imply source endorsement or use FAIR-MOFs CC BY terms to override rights in linked article full text or separately controlled underlying crystal data.
datasets.projectHandlingZh: 不复制 FAIR-MOFs CIF 归档。物化交叉层只保留与当前 CoRE 结构完全一致的 CSD Refcode（3,451 条），且不覆盖 CoRE 主值；合成条件与 DOI 仍按原有 4,168 条登记。
datasets.projectHandlingEn: No FAIR-MOFs CIF archive is copied. The property cross-layer retains only CSD Refcodes identical to the current CoRE corpus (3,451 records) and never overwrites CoRE primary values; synthesis conditions and DOI links remain registered for 4,168 records.

datasets.name: NIST/ARPA-E ISODB and linked adsorption sources
datasets.roleZh: 气体吸附等温线与字段级来源
datasets.roleEn: Gas adsorption isotherms and field-level provenance
datasets.version: EcoMOF-AI gas adsorption v2.1 source snapshot
datasets.licence: Per-record/source terms; no blanket relicence asserted
datasets.publisher: NIST/ARPA-E ISODB and linked source publishers
datasets.allowedZh: 当前仅按字段级来源用于可追溯的吸附分析和计算性 IAST；具体再利用条件必须回到每条记录的来源。
datasets.allowedEn: Current use is limited to source-traceable adsorption analysis and computed IAST. Reuse terms must be checked at each record's source.
datasets.prohibitedZh: 不主张整库统一开放许可，不把链接论文或第三方记录重新许可给用户。
datasets.prohibitedEn: No blanket open licence is asserted for the corpus, and linked articles or third-party records are not relicensed to users.
datasets.projectHandlingZh: 保留字段级来源、数据等级与计算/实验区分；不发布来源未确认的批量原始档案。
datasets.projectHandlingEn: Preserve field-level provenance and computed/experimental grades; do not publish bulk raw archives with unresolved source rights.

datasets.name: Curated literature and DOI metadata
datasets.roleZh: 文献层级证据、方法和来源指针
datasets.roleEn: Article-level evidence, methods, and source pointers
datasets.licence: Bibliographic facts and per-source permissions; no article-full-text relicence
datasets.allowedZh: 保留必要的书目信息、DOI、短摘要式事实和来源指针，用于科研溯源。
datasets.allowedEn: Preserve necessary bibliographic metadata, DOI, concise factual summaries, and source pointers for research provenance.
datasets.prohibitedZh: 不批量复制论文全文、图表或补充材料；数据集许可不替代出版物版权。
datasets.prohibitedEn: Do not bulk-copy article full text, figures, or supplements; dataset licences do not replace publication copyright.
datasets.projectHandlingZh: DOI 只作文献层级关联，不作结构同一性的单独证据。
datasets.projectHandlingEn: DOI is article-level association only and never sole evidence of structural identity.

datasets.name: MOF Anatomy factual identity and literature pointer index
datasets.roleZh: 185 条 MOF 名称、分类、年份、原论文 DOI 与 CCDC 来源指针
datasets.roleEn: 185 MOF name, class, year, source-paper DOI, and CCDC pointers
datasets.licence: No explicit site-wide reuse licence located; factual metadata and links only
datasets.allowedZh: 仅登记名称、年份、分类、DOI、CCDC 号及指向原站和原论文的链接，用于科研检索与缺失说明。
datasets.allowedEn: Register names, year, class, DOI, CCDC number, and outbound source links only for research retrieval and gap reporting.
datasets.prohibitedZh: 不得复制站点图片、XYZ／整理后结构、页面文案或设计；不得把目录身份条目当作获得物化性质授权或结构同一性的单独凭证。
datasets.prohibitedEn: Do not copy site images, XYZ/cleaned structures, page prose, or design, and do not treat an identity directory entry as authorization for properties or sole evidence of structure identity.
datasets.projectHandlingZh: 生成 185 条事实性身份索引；搜索命中但本地无精确结构／性质记录时，只显示 DOI、CCDC 号、来源页和缺失原因，不推断数值。
datasets.projectHandlingEn: Builds a 185-record factual identity index. When search finds a name without an exact local structure/property record, the UI shows DOI, CCDC number, source page, and the gap reason, without inferring values.
